overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: At the recommended high_and_moderate threshold, the RAG detects 2 of 3 positive reasoning segments with no false alarms (hit_rate 0.6667, F1 0.8000).
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: At high_and_moderate, strict instance identification has 0 true positives, 3 false negatives, and 2 false positives (precision, recall, and F1 all 0.0000) because both identified labels are near neighbors rather than approved hidden-label equivalents.
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: At high_and_moderate, mechanism-first scoring gives 2 true positives, 1 false negative, and 0 false positives (precision 1.0000, recall 0.6667, F1 0.8000).
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: The candidate tier is valuable: cand_001 is a useful abstention that exactly matches the hidden Satisficing instance when candidates are counted, raising candidate-inclusive segment detection to perfect performance.
main_failure_modes: Two correctly localized and mechanistically faithful findings use near-neighbor labels (Representativeness heuristic for Stereotyping and Motivated reasoning for Incentive bias), producing strict false positives and false negatives.
The Satisficing instance is not identified at ordinary confidence thresholds because it is retained only as a candidate.
main_strengths: All reported identified findings are grounded in valid interview quotes and correctly localized.
The two identified findings fully capture their hidden mechanisms despite label mismatch.
The RAG correctly avoids inventing a bias in the commissioning segment and provides a well-supported candidate for the ambiguous density-selection segment.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This run shows strong evidence and localization quality with a substantial taxonomy gap: mechanism-first scoring is much higher than strict label-plus-mechanism scoring. Including candidates recovers all three hidden instances, while the no-retrieval-support condition cannot be used to assess corpus fidelity.
